execution_unit: one independent candidate section per API request; five candidate audits assembled back into the original packet
strict_constraint_mapping: Integer 0-5 score ranges are represented by enums. Nonempty-string constraints are enforced by candidate-level and final local validation because the provider rejected the equivalent regex grammar as too complex.
format_reminder: Each request explicitly requires substantive nonempty claim_text, claim rationale, and audit_rationale fields. This is an output-completeness instruction and does not change the rubric.
acceptance_rule: A packet is complete only when Candidate A-E are each returned once and the assembled packet passes the unchanged canonical validator.
transport_normalization: Repeated identical cited-evidence labels within one claim are reduced to their first occurrence in order. This preserves the evidence-label set and does not alter scores, support status, claims, or rationales; every occurrence is recorded in the run manifest.
prompt_cache: The unchanged supplementary module is marked with an ephemeral cache breakpoint.
methodological_effect: No scoring change. Pass 2 already requires independent candidate audits; splitting is a transport amendment required by the provider grammar-size limit. Blinding, rubric, source abstracts, score scales, and canonical validation are unchanged.
